description: Chicago Traffic Tracker - Historical Congestion Estimates by Region - 2013-2018 is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. This dataset contains the historical estimated congestion for the 29 traffic regions, from January 2013 to May 2018. Coverage: Chicago. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are historical, traffic, link to article present, sustainability. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Chicago. The portal shows 2018-05-03 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofchicago-org-portal.
